title: TriviApp
description: A trivia game with category-based quizzes, Firebase sign-in and score tracking. Questions come from OpenTriviaDB, with day/night themes and a companion widget.

title: Calculator & Currency Converter
description: A native Android utility written in Kotlin. Combines everyday calculations with currency conversion using exchange-rate data from fixer.io.
imageAlt: Original Calculator and Currency Converter icon

title: Rick and Morty
description: A Flutter application for browsing characters and their details from the Rick and Morty API, using BLoC for state management and Dio for networking.

title: Get A Room
description: A university thesis project exploring hotel and motel booking and property management, with an Android client communicating with a backend through Volley.
imageAlt: Original Get A Room app icon

title: Popular Movies
description: A movie discovery app with trailers, reviews and offline favourites, powered by The Movie DB. Includes layouts for phones and tablets.

title: Baking App
description: Step-by-step recipes with video playback, tablet layouts and a home-screen widget. Uses ExoPlayer for media and Espresso for UI testing.

title: Pokédex
description: A React Native exploration for Android and iOS, featuring searchable Pokémon lists and detail screens with stats, types and abilities from PokeAPI.
